en.t: The title of this chapter is based on this poem.

units.source_text: 此诗根据催马乐《东屋》，其词曰：“（男）我在东屋檐下立，斜风细雨湿我裳。

en.t: This poem is based on the saibara song Azumaya, whose words run: "(Man) I stand beneath the eaves of the eastern house, while slanting wind and fine rain soak my clothes.

units.source_text: 多谢我的好姐姐，快快开门接情郎。

en.t: Many thanks, my dear lady; quickly open the door and welcome your lover.

units.source_text: （女）此门无锁又无闩，一推便开无阻挡。

en.t: (Woman) This door has neither lock nor bolt; one push will open it, with nothing in the way.

units.source_text: 请你自己推开门，我是你的好妻房。”

en.t: Please push the door open yourself; I am your good wife."

units.source_text: 参看第一百七十五页注。
